description: rmAGENT (AgentTokenVault) launch shortlist: RM only, the live ROBOTMONEY token pinned by code hash like USDC, on the Uniswap V4 RM/USDC 2.91% pool (owner decision 2026-10-08; the V3 RM pool has no in-range liquidity). V4 has no pool address and a hookless V4 pool records no observations, so rmAGENT prices RM through the permissionless UniswapV4PriceRecorder, which the agent stage reads from RECORDER_ADDRESS. Other agent tokens are added later through the timelock. One list for every chain. swapRouter02 is the Uniswap V3 SwapRouter02 the vault constructor takes; the V4 adapter trades through the PoolManager, not the router. maxSlippageBps raises the vault swap bound to the 500 bps ceiling because the pool fee alone is 291 bps.
